label: Portfolio turnover
note: Reported in the financial-highlights table of N-CSR/N-CSRS. No direction: high turnover is a strategy choice, not a quality.

label: Non-accrual rate (% of portfolio, fair value)
prose_patterns: non-?accrual investments as a percentage of total investments at cost and fair value were\s*[0-9.]+\s*%\s*and\s*([0-9]{1,2}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)\s*%
note: Proxy for default rate on a FAIR VALUE basis. Shipped alongside the cost-basis version so the choice of basis is a render decision rather than a question that blocks extraction -- filers state both in one sentence and the two are not interchangeable.

label: Non-accrual rate (% of portfolio, cost)
prose_patterns: non-?accrual investments as a percentage of total investments at cost and fair value were\s*([0-9]{1,2}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)\s*%
note: Same disclosure, COST basis. Cost runs higher than fair value because written-down positions carry less fair value; comparing one fund's cost figure against another's fair-value figure would overstate the difference.

label: Weighted average spread (bps)
note: Stated inconsistently across filers -- some quote spread over benchmark, some all-in yield. Expect low coverage and check the excerpt before using.
